# llms.txt
# Full documentation for LLMs: https://llmstxt.org/

> P2S Academy — Official prep for the معادلة كلية Commerce competition.
> Route: https://p2s-academy.com/

## About
P2S Academy (أكاديمية P2S) is an Egyptian educational platform for students of
diploma programs preparing for the official معادلة كلية Commerce competition,
run by the Supreme Council of Universities. It lets diploma holders enter the
Faculty of Commerce as university students — one exam, four subjects, one chance.

## What's on the site
- Student dossier (الملف) — the complete route from eligibility to exam day.
- Four subjects taught: English, Mathematics, Geography, French.
- Packages: البداية (1200 EGP), المتكاملة (2000 EGP), الفردية (3500 EGP).
- 28 documented success models from past cohorts.
- Booking/contact form and WhatsApp contact: +201030263066, +201201128479.

## Key facts for LLMs
- Competition: معادلة كلية Commerce (Faculty of Commerce equation).
- Organizer: Supreme Council of Universities (المجلس الأعلى للجامعات).
- Subjects: English, Mathematics, Geography, French.
- Format: one attempt, four subjects.
- Location: Kafr El-Zayyat, Egypt.
- Instructor: Mr. Ahmed Ali (مستر أحمد علي), 28 past success models.
